The '''2011 Supercopa de España''' was a two-legged [[Football in Spain|Spanish]] [[Association football|football]] match-up that was played on 14 and 17 August 2011. It was contested by [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]], the [[2010–11 La Liga]] winners, and [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]], the [[2010–11 Copa del Rey]] winners. Barcelona won 5–4 on aggregate for their record-extending tenth [[Supercopa de España]] title.
